system.description:
You Fire your weapon with such a high arc that it eclipses the sun or moon, using the shadows generated to mask its approach. When you cast this jutsu make your ranged taijutsu attack and on a hit, determine how many turns (up to a max of 3 rounds) before the arrow strikes, prolonging your adversaries dread. This jutsu’s base damage is [Weapons damage] + 4d12. For every round beyond the one you cast this jutsu in that you delay, this jutsu increases in damage by 2d12.

The shot will finally land and strike its target after the declared number of rounds at the beginning of your turn on that round.

Chain 2: Select up to 3 targets for this jutsu, making a single attack comparing the result to each of their AC and applying its effects on a hit.

Chain 3: For every round this jutsu’s damage is delayed, on a hit the affected creature gains 4 ranks of Bleed when the damage is applied.
